prompt: The university library _____ its opening hours during the final exam week.
explanation: Subjek tunggal 'The university library' menyatakan jadwal atau kebiasaan rutin, sehingga menggunakan Present Simple 'extends'.
learningTip: Gunakan Present Simple untuk jadwal resmi atau rutinitas institusional.

prompt: If the train arrives on schedule, we _____ enough time to catch the connecting flight.
explanation: Pola First Conditional: klausa 'if' memakai Present Simple ('arrives'), klausa utama memakai 'will + verb dasar'.
learningTip: Pasangan First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + V1 untuk situasi yang realistis di masa depan.

prompt: The historical city centre _____ by thousands of international tourists each summer.
explanation: Subjek 'The historical city centre' menerima aksi secara rutin setiap musim panas, sehingga bentuk passive yang tepat adalah 'is visited'.
learningTip: Pola Present Simple Passive: am/is/are + V3 untuk menyatakan fakta atau kebiasaan pasif.

prompt: Dr. Evans has worked at the marine biology laboratory _____ more than fifteen years.
explanation: Preposisi 'for' digunakan untuk menunjukkan total rentang durasi waktu ('more than fifteen years').
learningTip: Bedakan 'for' (durasi waktu) dan 'since' (titik awal waktu).

prompt: She decided to study environmental science _____ she could help address global climate issues.
explanation: Konjungsi 'so that' diikuti klausa lengkap (subjek + modal + verb) untuk menyatakan tujuan.
learningTip: 'So that' diikuti klausa (S + modal + V), sedangkan 'in order to' diikuti kata kerja dasar.

prompt: Students _____ carry their identification badges whenever entering the examination hall.
explanation: Modal 'must' menyatakan kewajiban mutlak atau aturan resmi tanpa tambahan 'to'.
learningTip: Gunakan 'must' untuk peraturan formal yang wajib dipatuhi.

prompt: The scholarship committee has not made a final decision _____.
explanation: 'Yet' diletakkan di akhir kalimat negatif Present Perfect untuk menyatakan sesuatu yang belum terjadi hingga saat ini.
learningTip: Gunakan 'yet' di akhir kalimat tanya dan negatif dalam tenses perfect.

prompt: While the professor was delivering the lecture, a loud alarm suddenly _____ outside.
explanation: Aksi pendek yang memotong aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lampau menggunakan Past Simple ('rang').
learningTip: Pola 'While + Past Continuous, Past Simple' lazim digunakan untuk kejadian yang memotong kejadian lain.

prompt: Living in a student dormitory is usually _____ than renting a private apartment downtown.
explanation: Kata sambung 'than' menandai perbandingan komparatif, sehingga kata sifat multi-silabel menggunakan 'more affordable'.
learningTip: Gunakan 'more + adjective' untuk comparative pada kata dengan dua suku kata atau lebih.

prompt: The tutor asked the study group _____ their assignment by Friday afternoon.
explanation: Pola kata kerja perintah/permintaan tidak langsung: ask + someone + to-infinitive ('to submit').
learningTip: Kata kerja reporting seperti ask, tell, remind, advise diikuti pola: object + to-infinitive.

prompt: Neither the lecture room nor the computer laboratories _____ available this morning.
explanation: Pada struktur 'neither... nor', kata kerja mengikuti subjek terdekat yaitu 'computer laboratories' (jamak), sehingga memakai 'were'.
learningTip: Perhatikan subject-verb agreement pada paired conjunctions: ikuti subjek yang paling dekat dengan kata kerja.

prompt: The article provides _____ useful advice for candidates preparing for the IELTS Academic test.
explanation: Kata 'advice' adalah kata benda tak terhitung (uncountable noun), sehingga tidak bisa memakai 'an', 'many', atau 'several'. 'A lot of' dapat digunakan untuk uncountable nouns.
learningTip: 'Advice' dan 'information' selalu bersifat uncountable; tidak pernah memakai 'an' atau akhiran '-s'.

prompt: We are really looking forward to _____ our exchange semester in Melbourne.
explanation: Frasa 'look forward to' memiliki 'to' sebagai preposisi, sehingga wajib diikuti oleh gerund ('starting').
learningTip: Hati-hati dengan frasa berakhiran preposisi 'to' seperti 'look forward to' dan 'be used to'; kata kerjanya berakhiran -ing.

prompt: The athlete managed to win the tournament _____ injuring his ankle in the preliminary round.
explanation: 'Despite' adalah preposisi yang diikuti oleh gerund ('injuring'), sedangkan 'although' membutuhkan klausa penuh (subjek + verb).
learningTip: Gunakan 'despite / in spite of' sebelum frasa benda atau gerund (-ing).

prompt: By the time we reached the cinema, the movie _____ already begun.
explanation: Aksi yang sudah tuntas sebelum waktu lampau tertentu ('reached') diungkapkan dengan Past Perfect ('had begun').
learningTip: Kombinasi 'By the time + Past Simple' berpasangan dengan Past Perfect pada klausa utama.

prompt: The applicant _____ spoke three languages fluently was offered the marketing role.
explanation: Kata ganti penghubung (relative pronoun) yang berfungsi sebagai subjek pengganti orang ('the applicant') adalah 'who'.
learningTip: Gunakan 'who' sebagai subjek orang, 'which' untuk benda, dan 'whose' untuk kepemilikan.

prompt: You had better _____ your passport before booking non-refundable tickets.
explanation: Frasa saran kuat 'had better' selalu diikuti oleh bare infinitive (kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to').
learningTip: 'Had better' diikuti bentuk dasar kata kerja (V1) tanpa 'to'.

prompt: The supervisor asked if I _____ any prior experience with qualitative research software.
explanation: Dalam kalimat tidak langsung (indirect speech) dengan reporting verb lampau ('asked'), tenses bergeser mundur (backshift) menjadi Past Simple 'had'.
learningTip: Perhatikan pergeseran tenses (backshift) saat mengubah kalimat langsung menjadi tidak langsung.

prompt: If I _____ more free time this weekend, I would volunteer at the animal shelter.
explanation: Second Conditional untuk situasi hipotetis saat ini: If + Past Simple ('had'), would + bare verb ('would volunteer').
learningTip: Pola Second Conditional: If + Simple Past, would + V1 untuk pengandaian yang berlawanan dengan fakta saat ini.

prompt: The museum gallery was _____ crowded that visitors had difficulty viewing the paintings.
explanation: Kata sifat tunggal 'crowded' dihubungkan dengan klausa akibat 'that...' menggunakan pasangan 'so... that'.
learningTip: Pola perbandingan derajat akibat: so + adjective + that, sedangkan such + noun phrase + that.

prompt: Rarely _____ such widespread agreement among international economists regarding tariff policies.
explanation: Adverb negatif pembatas 'Rarely' di awal kalimat memicu inversi: kata bantu 'does' mendahului subjek 'one'.
learningTip: Inversi negatif: Letakkan kata bantu sebelum subjek setelah kata seperti rarely, seldom, hardly, scarcely.

prompt: Had the engineering department received additional funding, they _____ the prototype earlier.
explanation: Inversi Third Conditional ('Had they received...') bermakna 'If they had received...' dan berpasangan dengan 'would have + V3'.
learningTip: Inversi kondisi lampau: 'Had + S + V3' selalu berpasangan dengan 'would have + V3' di klausa utama.

prompt: The advisory committee insisted that each candidate _____ their financial declarations promptly.
explanation: Mandative Subjunctive: setelah kata kerja tuntutan formal 'insisted that', kata kerja klausa berikutnya berbentuk bare infinitive ('submit').
learningTip: Setelah kata kerja insist, demand, recommend, propose + that, gunakan bentuk kata kerja dasar murni tanpa akhiran -s.

prompt: By the time the symposium concludes tomorrow evening, the panel _____ over fifty research abstracts.
explanation: Keterangan waktu batas masa depan 'By the time...' berpasangan dengan Future Perfect ('will have evaluated').
learningTip: Gunakan Future Perfect (will have + V3) untuk aksi yang diproyeksikan selesai sebelum batas waktu tertentu di masa depan.

prompt: The architect had the structural blueprints _____ by an independent civil engineer.
explanation: Causative Passive: pola 'have + something + V3' ('had the blueprints reviewed') menyatakan bahwa suatu objek diperiksa oleh pihak lain.
learningTip: Pola causative pasif: have/get + object + V3.

prompt: Under no circumstances _____ allowed to handle radioactive material without supervisory clearance.
explanation: Frasa pembatas negatif di awal kalimat ('Under no circumstances') memicu inversi kata kerja bantu sebelum subjek ('are students').
learningTip: Frasa seperti 'Under no circumstances' atau 'On no account' selalu diikuti pola inversi pertanyaan (Aux + S + V).

prompt: The more rigorously the data is scrutinized, _____ the underlying seasonal trends become.
explanation: Double Comparative berimbang: kedua sisi kalimat harus menggunakan pola 'The + comparative' ('The more rigorously..., the clearer...').
learningTip: Pastikan kedua sisi klausa sejajar: The + comparative ..., the + comparative ...

prompt: _____ the preliminary findings with senior staff, the research director drafted the press release.
explanation: Perfect Participle ('Having discussed') digunakan untuk menunjukkan bahwa tindakan diskusi telah selesai sepenuhnya sebelum tindakan berikutnya dilakukan.
learningTip: Gunakan 'Having + V3' untuk menyatakan urutan aksi yang sudah selesai sebelum klausa utama.

prompt: The ancient manuscript, _____ in a cave near the Dead Sea, provided invaluable historical insights.
explanation: Reduced Relative Clause pasif: bentuk 'which was discovered' disederhanakan menjadi past participle 'discovered'.
learningTip: Reduced relative clause pasif cukup menggunakan bentuk V3 tanpa kata bantu to be.

prompt: Were the municipal government _____ public transport fares, city traffic would decrease noticeably.
explanation: Inversi Second Conditional: bentuk 'Were + subjek + to-infinitive' ('Were the government to subsidize...') setara dengan 'If the government subsidized...'.
learningTip: Pola inversi pengandaian formal masa kini/depan: Were + S + to + V1.

prompt: No sooner had the keynote speaker stepped onto the stage _____ the microphone failed.
explanation: Pasangan baku untuk konstruksi inversi waktu 'No sooner had...' adalah 'than'.
learningTip: 'No sooner' selalu berpasangan dengan 'than', sedangkan 'Hardly/Scarcely' berpasangan dengan 'when'.

prompt: The committee commended the team, noting that they _____ exceptional resilience during the crisis.
explanation: Past Perfect 'had shown' tepat untuk aksi ketahanan yang telah ditunjukkan sebelum rapat komite berlangsung di masa lampau.
learningTip: Gunakan Past Perfect untuk aksi lampau yang terjadi mendahului aksi lampau lainnya.

prompt: The new emission standards are said _____ by industrial manufacturers nationwide next year.
explanation: Pola pasif 'is said + to be + V3' digunakan untuk menyatakan bahwa subjek akan dikenai suatu tindakan oleh pihak lain.
learningTip: Pola pasif pelaporan: be said / believed / expected + to be + V3.

prompt: If the conservation project _____ initiated five years ago, the coral reef would not be thriving today.
explanation: Mixed Conditional: klausa 'if' mengandaikan peristiwa lampau yang tidak terjadi ('had not been initiated'), sedangkan klausa utama menunjukkan dampaknya pada saat ini ('today').
learningTip: Ciri Mixed Conditional: If + Past Perfect dipadukan dengan would + bare verb yang memiliki penanda waktu 'today/now'.

prompt: The university provost recommended that the faculty _____ on improving online student engagement.
explanation: Subjunctive mood setelah 'recommended that' mewajibkan pemakaian kata kerja dasar ('focus') terlepas dari bentuk subjeknya.
learningTip: Setelah recommend/suggest/propose that, jangan tambahkan akhiran -s atau -ed pada kata kerja.

prompt: It was her groundbreaking dissertation on urban hydrology _____ earned her the prestigious fellowship.
explanation: Cleft Sentence penekanan: pola formal 'It was [fokus] that [klausa]' menggunakan relative pronoun 'that' untuk memberikan penekanan khusus.
learningTip: Pola Cleft Sentence penekanan: It is/was + fokus informasi + that + kalimat penjelas.

prompt: The expedition team brought extra communication gear _____ the satellite uplink failed in the mountains.
explanation: 'In case' digunakan untuk tindakan pencegahan menghadapi kemungkinan buruk di masa depan ('jika sewaktu-waktu...').
learningTip: Gunakan 'in case' untuk tindakan pencegahan (precaution), bukan 'if' biasa.

prompt: The newly appointed CEO is widely considered _____ one of the most visionary leaders in the tech sector.
explanation: Pola pasif akademik 'is considered' secara baku dilengkapi to-infinitive 'to be'.
learningTip: Pola baku ragam tulisan akademik: be considered to be + noun/adjective.

prompt: Not until the lab received the chemical analysis _____ the true cause of the river contamination.
explanation: Frasa 'Not until...' di awal kalimat memicu inversi pada klausa utama: kata kerja bantu 'did' mendahului subjek 'the team'.
learningTip: Pada pola 'Not until [klausa], [inversi klausa utama]', letakkan aux sebelum subjek pada klausa utama.

prompt: Given the rigorous security protocols, the intruder _____ entered the facility through the front entrance.
explanation: Modal deduksi lampau: 'cannot have + V3' menyatakan kesimpulan logis bahwa suatu kejadian mustahil terjadi di masa lalu.
learningTip: Gunakan 'cannot have + V3' untuk menyimpulkan kemustahilan logis di masa lampau.

prompt: Identify the error: The detailed survey [provides] [much] useful [suggestions] for local urban [planners].
explanation: Kata 'suggestions' adalah kata benda jamak terhitung (countable plural), sehingga harus dipasangkan dengan 'many', bukan 'much'.
learningTip: Gunakan many untuk countable plural dan much untuk uncountable singular.

prompt: Identify the error: Although the international delegates [struggled] with jet lag, [despite] they [participated] actively in every [workshop].
explanation: Penggunaan 'Although' di awal kalimat sudah cukup menghubungkan kedua klausa; penambahan 'despite' merupakan pengulangan konjungsi yang salah.
learningTip: Jangan gabungkan konjungsi bertingkat (although/even though) dengan kata penghubung kontras lain (despite/but) dalam satu kalimat.

prompt: Identify the error: The research assistant [completed] the statistical analysis [remarkable] quickly despite [unexpected] software [glitches].
explanation: Kata 'quickly' adalah kata keterangan (adverb), sehingga kata yang menerangkannya harus berupa adverb ('remarkably'), bukan adjective 'remarkable'.
learningTip: Gunakan adverb (berakhiran -ly) untuk menerangkan adjective atau adverb lainnya.

prompt: Identify the error: If the weather conditions [improve] tomorrow, our class will [went] on a botanical [field] [trip].
explanation: Setelah kata bantu modal 'will', kata kerja wajib berbentuk dasar murni (bare infinitive: 'go'), bukan bentuk lampau 'went'.
learningTip: Modal auxiliary (will, can, must, should) selalu diikuti kata kerja bentuk dasar tanpa to.

prompt: Identify the error: The majority of local residents [were] extremely [satisfied] with the new public [transportations] in the city [centre].
explanation: Kata 'transportation' adalah kata benda massa yang tidak dapat dihitung (uncountable) dan tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran jamak -s.
learningTip: Catat kata benda tak terhitung umum seperti transportation, accommodation, luggage, furniture.

prompt: Identify the error: The visiting delegation [arrived] at the university [auditorium] promptly [in] Tuesday morning for the [orientation].
explanation: Untuk keterangan waktu yang menyebutkan hari spesifik ('Tuesday morning'), preposisi yang benar adalah 'on', bukan 'in'.
learningTip: Gunakan preposisi 'on' untuk hari dan tanggal spesifik (on Monday, on July 4th).

prompt: Identify the error: The senior biochemist succeeded [in] [isolate] the active protein [compound] from tropical plant [specimens].
explanation: Kata kerja yang diletakkan tepat setelah preposisi ('in') harus berbentuk gerund ('isolating'), bukan kata kerja dasar 'isolate'.
learningTip: Semua kata kerja setelah preposition (in, on, at, about, by) wajib berakhiran -ing.

prompt: Identify the error: Long-term academic [progress] heavily [depends] [of] consistent daily study [habits] and active class participation.
explanation: Kata kerja 'depend' memiliki pasangan preposisi baku yaitu 'on' ('depend on'), bukan 'depend of'.
learningTip: Pelajari dependent preposition sebagai satu kesatuan pasangan tetap (depend on, rely on).

prompt: Identify the error: The municipal council [considers] the proposed bicycle lane [network] to be highly [beneficial] for public [healthy].
explanation: Setelah kata sifat penjelas 'public', dibutuhkan kata benda yaitu 'health' (kesehatan), bukan kata sifat 'healthy' (sehat).
learningTip: Identifikasi kelas kata (part of speech) yang dibutuhkan kalimat: tentukan apakah noun atau adjective.

prompt: Identify the error: The keynote speaker delivered an [inspiring] lecture that [had] a profound [affect] on every student in the [audience].
explanation: Dalam frasa 'had a profound...', posisi tersebut membutuhkan kata benda 'effect' (pengaruh/dampak), bukan kata kerja 'affect'.
learningTip: Ingat: 'affect' umumnya adalah verb (mempengaruhi), sedangkan 'effect' adalah noun (akibat/pengaruh).

prompt: Identify the error: At the annual conference, the lead [scientist] [which] [directed] the project was [awarded] a gold medal.
explanation: Subjek 'the lead scientist' adalah manusia, sehingga kata ganti penghubung (relative pronoun) yang benar adalah 'who', bukan 'which'.
learningTip: Gunakan 'who' untuk manusia dan 'which' untuk benda mati atau konsep abstrak.

prompt: Identify the error: The environmental organization focuses [on] reducing plastic [waste], conserving clean water, and [to promote] solar [energy].
explanation: Dalam susunan paralel setelah preposisi 'on', bentuk kata kerja harus konsisten berupa gerund ('promoting'), sejajar dengan 'reducing'.
learningTip: Prinsip paralelisme: pastikan deretan elemen kata kerja dalam satu frasa memiliki struktur gramatikal yang setara.

prompt: Identify the error: Each of the participating [universities] [have] established a dedicated innovation [hub] for undergraduate [students].
explanation: Subjek kalimat adalah 'Each', yang bernilai tunggal (singular). Oleh karena itu kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'has established', bukan 'have established'.
learningTip: Frasa 'Each of + plural noun' selalu mengambil kata kerja tunggal (singular verb).

prompt: Identify the error: The university campus has [maintained] an outstanding international [reputation] [about] scientific research and [teaching].
explanation: Kata benda 'reputation' berkolokasi dengan preposisi 'for' ('reputation for scientific research'), bukan 'about'.
learningTip: Perhatikan kolokasi preposisi tetap: have a reputation for something.

prompt: Identify the error: The postgraduate fellow has been [conducting] extensive fieldwork in the rain forest [since] three [consecutive] [years].
explanation: Untuk menyatakan rentang total durasi ('three consecutive years'), preposisi yang tepat adalah 'for', bukan 'since'.
learningTip: Gunakan 'for' untuk panjangnya periode waktu dan 'since' untuk patokan awal waktu tertentu.

prompt: Identify the error: [Having saw] the preliminary survey [data], the chief environmental officer [ordered] an immediate [re-examination].
explanation: Pola Perfect Participle mewajibkan pemakaian kata kerja bentuk ketiga (V3: 'Having seen'), bukan bentuk kedua 'Having saw'.
learningTip: Pola Perfect Participle selalu: Having + Past Participle (V3).

prompt: Identify the error: The ethics board [insisted] that the lead researcher [submits] all raw interview [transcripts] before the publication [date].
explanation: Setelah kata kerja tuntutan formal 'insisted that', klausa mandative subjunctive mewajibkan kata kerja dasar ('submit'), tanpa akhiran -s.
learningTip: Subjunctive mood: kata kerja setelah insist/recommend/demand + that selalu memakai bare infinitive murni.

prompt: Identify the error: The [more] rigorously the laboratory technicians tested the water samples, the [most] reliable the safety [assessments] [became].
explanation: Pola double comparative berimbang membutuhkan bentuk komparatif di kedua sisi ('the more reliable', bukan 'the most').
learningTip: Ingat struktur berimbang: The + comparative ..., the + comparative ...

prompt: Identify the error: The supervisory committee [made] the postgraduate students [to rewrite] the entire introductory chapter of [their] [dissertation].
explanation: Kata kerja causative aktif 'make' diikuti objek dan bare infinitive tanpa to ('rewrite'), bukan 'to rewrite'.
learningTip: Kata kerja causative make dan let dalam kalimat aktif selalu diikuti V1 polos (bare infinitive).

prompt: Identify the error: Seldom [they had] [encountered] such unprecedented levels of community participation during the municipal [planning] [phase].
explanation: Ketika adverbial negatif 'Seldom' mengawali kalimat, posisi kata kerja bantu harus dibalik mendahului subjek ('had they encountered').
learningTip: Adverbial negatif di awal kalimat (seldom, rarely, hardly) memicu pembalikan kata bantu dan subjek (inversi).

prompt: Identify the error: The digital archive maintains [detailed] [researches] and valuable statistical records on historical demographic [patterns] in [Europe].
explanation: Dalam konteks akademik standar, kata 'research' merupakan kata benda tak terhitung (uncountable) dan tidak boleh memakai bentuk jamak 'researches'.
learningTip: Gunakan 'research' sebagai kata benda tak terhitung, atau 'research studies' jika ingin menghitungnya.

prompt: Identify the error: The newly appointed director of institutional relations [were] confident that the university would [meet] its strategic [goals] [easily].
explanation: Inti subjek kalimat adalah 'The newly appointed director' (tunggal). Frasa penjelas 'of institutional relations' tidak mengubah subjek, sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'was'.
learningTip: Abaikan frasa preposisi penjelas di antara subjek dan kata kerja saat menentukan singular/plural verb.

prompt: Identify the error: Each of the participating research institutes has submitted [they] official feedback to the international [accreditation] [steering] [committee].
explanation: Sebelum frasa kata benda 'official feedback', harus menggunakan kata sifat kepemilikan (possessive adjective) 'their', bukan kata ganti subjek 'they'.
learningTip: Gunakan possessive adjective (their, its, his, her) tepat sebelum noun atau noun phrase.

prompt: Identify the error: The university administration [implemented] strict network protocols to prevent external hackers [to] [infiltrating] the student records [system].
explanation: Pola kata kerja 'prevent' adalah 'prevent someone from doing something', sehingga preposisi yang tepat adalah 'from', bukan 'to'.
learningTip: Ingat pola verba pencegahan: prevent / stop / prohibit someone from + V-ing.

prompt: Identify the error: The statistical evaluation proved that the second vaccine trial was [substantially] [more] effective [as] the earlier laboratory [experiment].
explanation: Bentuk perbandingan lebih ('more effective') harus dipasangkan dengan kata sambung pembanding 'than', bukan 'as'.
learningTip: Setelah comparative (more / -er), kata sambung perbandingan selalu 'than'.

prompt: Identify the error: The academic senate [convened] yesterday afternoon to [discuss] [about] the proposed revisions to the faculty tenure [policy].
explanation: Kata kerja transitif 'discuss' langsung mengambil objek langsung tanpa tambahan preposisi 'about' ('discuss the proposed revisions').
learningTip: Kata kerja transitif seperti discuss, consider, describe tidak membutuhkan preposisi tambahan.

prompt: Identify the error: Neither the chief [editor] nor the senior reviewers [was] informed that the article had already been [accepted] by another [journal].
explanation: Pada struktur 'neither... nor', kata kerja mengikuti subjek terdekat yaitu 'senior reviewers' (jamak), sehingga kata kerja yang benar adalah 'were'.
learningTip: Cocokkan bentuk kata kerja dengan subjek terdekat pada konjungsi berpasangan (either...or, neither...nor).

prompt: Identify the error: The theoretical explanation proposed by the visiting scholar seemed entirely [reasonable] and [logically] to the entire [faculty] [panel].
explanation: Setelah linking verb 'seemed', kata yang digunakan harus berupa predicative adjective ('logical'), sejajar dengan 'reasonable', bukan adverb 'logically'.
learningTip: Linking verbs (seem, appear, look, taste, sound) selalu diikuti adjective, bukan adverb.

prompt: Identify the error: The research team spent several [months] [to develop] a comprehensive computer simulation for coastal erosion [risk] [mitigation].
explanation: Pola ekspresi 'spend time' diikuti gerund ('developing'), bukan to-infinitive 'to develop'.
learningTip: Pola verba baku: spend + time/money + V-ing.

prompt: Identify the error: The executive [board] resolved the internal corporate governance dispute by [themself] before [seeking] external legal [guidance].
explanation: Bentuk reflexive pronoun untuk subjek jamak 'the executive board' (merujuk pada para anggotanya) adalah 'themselves', bukan 'themself' (yang tidak baku).
learningTip: Reflexive pronoun untuk third person plural selalu 'themselves'.

prompt: The city council decided to _____ new speed limits near elementary schools to ensure student safety.
explanation: 'Implement' berarti menerapkan atau menjalankan kebijakan/peraturan secara resmi.
learningTip: Collocation akademik: implement a policy / rule / reform.

prompt: Regular physical exercise can _____ a significant impact on mental wellbeing.
explanation: Pasangan kolokasi baku dalam bahasa Inggris adalah 'have an impact on', bukan 'make' atau 'do'.
learningTip: Hafalkan kolokasi kata benda: have an impact on, have an effect on, have an influence on.

prompt: The survey revealed that air pollution remains a _____ concern for urban residents.
explanation: 'Major concern' adalah kolokasi umum yang berarti kekhawatiran utama atau sangat penting.
learningTip: Gunakan kata sifat akademik seperti major, pressing, urgent untuk menerangkan concern atau issue.

prompt: In the academic essay, the student provided _____ evidence to support her hypothesis.
explanation: 'Sufficient' berarti cukup dan memadai untuk memenuhi standar pembuktian.
learningTip: Sinonim akademik: sufficient = adequate = enough.

prompt: The sudden drop in temperature caused the water pipes to _____ and burst.
explanation: Air yang membeku ('freeze') memuai dan menyebabkan pipa pecah saat cuaca dingin ekstrem.
learningTip: Kuasai kosakata proses sains dasar: freeze, melt, condense, evaporate.

prompt: International students must demonstrate a high level of _____ in English before enrolling.
explanation: 'Proficiency' berarti kemahiran atau keahlian tingkat tinggi dalam suatu keterampilan atau bahasa.
learningTip: Kolokasi IELTS: language proficiency, demonstrate proficiency.

prompt: The university offered financial assistance to students from low-income _____.
explanation: 'Backgrounds' merujuk pada latar belakang sosial-ekonomi atau keluarga seseorang.
learningTip: Kolokasi sosiologi: socio-economic background, diverse backgrounds.

prompt: The new transit system is expected to _____ traffic congestion on the main highway.
explanation: 'Reduce' berarti mengurangi tingkat keparahan atau volume kemacetan.
learningTip: Sinonim bermanfaat untuk Task 2: reduce, decrease, diminish, alleviate.

prompt: Researchers conducted a detailed study to _____ the effectiveness of the new medication.
explanation: 'Evaluate' berarti menilai atau mengukur secara sistematis nilai atau efektivitas sesuatu.
learningTip: Academic Word List: evaluate, assess, analyze, determine.

prompt: Solar and wind energy are popular examples of _____ resources.
explanation: 'Renewable' berarti dapat diperbarui secara alami dan berkelanjutan tanpa habis.
learningTip: Kolokasi topik lingkungan IELTS: renewable energy, renewable resources.

prompt: The company had to _____ the product launch due to unforeseen technical difficulties.
explanation: 'Delay' berarti menunda pelaksanaan ke waktu yang lebih lambat.
learningTip: Sinonim: delay = postpone = put off.

prompt: The professor emphasized the _____ of submitting assignments before the deadline.
explanation: 'Importance' berarti signifikansi atau pentingnya suatu tindakan.
learningTip: Kolokasi: emphasize the importance of doing something.

prompt: The candidate gave a clear and _____ summary of his previous work experience.
explanation: 'Concise' berarti ringkas, padat, dan bebas dari kata-kata yang tidak perlu.
learningTip: Kombinasi kata deskriptif: clear and concise, brief and informative.

prompt: Living costs in major metropolitan areas have risen _____ over the past five years.
explanation: 'Significantly' menunjukkan peningkatan dalam jumlah yang besar dan bermakna penting.
learningTip: Adverb untuk IELTS Task 1: increase significantly, rise sharply, grow substantially.

prompt: A balanced diet and adequate sleep are _____ for maintaining optimal health.
explanation: 'Essential' berarti sangat mutlak dibutuhkan (crucial / indispensable).
learningTip: Sinonim kata kuat: essential = vital = crucial.

prompt: The government introduced strategic subsidies to _____ investment in green technologies.
explanation: 'Stimulate' berarti mendorong atau merangsang pertumbuhan aktivitas ekonomi/investasi.
learningTip: Kolokasi ekonomi akademik: stimulate growth, stimulate investment, stimulate the economy.

prompt: Urban planners must take proactive measures to _____ the catastrophic risks of flash flooding.
explanation: 'Mitigate' berarti mengurangi keparahan, bahaya, atau dampak buruk suatu bencana.
learningTip: Academic Word List (AWL): mitigate risk / impact / damage = reduce severity.

prompt: The researcher presented a _____ argument backed by ten years of empirical field data.
explanation: 'Compelling' berarti sangat meyakinkan, kuat, dan memikat secara intelektual.
learningTip: Kolokasi akademik tingkat tinggi: compelling argument / evidence / case.

prompt: Rapid industrial automation has fundamentally _____ the landscape of the manufacturing sector.
explanation: 'Transform' berarti mengubah secara mendalam bentuk, struktur, atau sifat sesuatu menjadi lebih maju.
learningTip: Gunakan 'transform' alih-alih kata sederhana 'change' dalam penulisan esai IELTS.

prompt: The findings of the preliminary study are entirely _____ with previous academic literature.
explanation: 'Consistent with' berarti selaras, cocok, dan tidak bertentangan dengan temuan terdahulu.
learningTip: Preposisi kolokasi akademik: consistent with, aligned with, in accordance with.

prompt: Failing to wear appropriate personal protective gear in the laboratory _____ a severe safety hazard.
explanation: 'Pose a risk / hazard' adalah kolokasi baku bahasa Inggris formal yang berarti menimbulkan atau menciptakan ancaman.
learningTip: Hafalkan kolokasi formal: pose a risk, pose a threat, pose a challenge.

prompt: The international summit concluded without reaching a broad _____ on binding carbon reductions.
explanation: 'Consensus' berarti kesepakatan bersama yang dicapai oleh semua pihak yang terlibat.
learningTip: Kolokasi diplomasi dan kebijakan: reach a consensus, broad consensus, general consensus.

prompt: Many developing island nations are exceptionally _____ to the adverse impacts of rising sea levels.
explanation: 'Vulnerable to' berarti rentan atau mudah terkena dampak bahaya dan kerusakan.
learningTip: Kolokasi lingkungan IELTS: vulnerable to climate change / extinction / diseases.

prompt: Technological innovation has played an _____ role in modernizing healthcare delivery systems.
explanation: 'Indispensable' berarti sangat esensial dan tidak mungkin ditiadakan (absolutely essential).
learningTip: Sinonim tingkat tinggi untuk 'important': indispensable, pivotal, integral, fundamental.

prompt: Heavy deforestation and agricultural expansion have led to the severe _____ of natural habitats.
explanation: 'Degradation' berarti proses kemunduran, perusakan, atau penurunan kualitas lingkungan.
learningTip: Topik lingkungan: environmental degradation, habitat loss, soil erosion.

prompt: The research team was careful not to draw premature _____ before analyzing the full sample size.
explanation: 'Draw conclusions' adalah kolokasi akademik baku yang berarti mengambil atau menarik kesimpulan.
learningTip: Kolokasi metodologi penelitian: draw a conclusion, reach a verdict, infer from data.

prompt: The new renewable energy legislation is designed to _____ reliance on imported fossil fuels.
explanation: 'Curtail' berarti membatasi, memangkas, atau mengurangi jangkauan suatu hal.
learningTip: Sinonim akademik untuk membatasi/memotong: curtail = restrict = curb.

prompt: Despite intense media scrutiny, the corporate executive remained _____ about the future merger.
explanation: 'Reticent' berarti enggan berbicara atau bersikap tertutup dan berhati-hati dalam memberikan komentar.
learningTip: Kosakata karakter/sikap formal: reticent = reserved = uncommunicative.

prompt: The latest smartphone prototype incorporates several _____ design features that enhance battery life.
explanation: 'Innovative' berarti menampilkan ide atau metode baru yang orisinal dan kreatif.
learningTip: Kosakata teknologi Task 2: innovative features, state-of-the-art technology, pioneering work.

prompt: The economic stimulus package was aimed at restoring consumer _____ following the financial downturn.
explanation: 'Consumer confidence' adalah kolokasi ekonomi baku yang merujuk pada optimisme dan keyakinan konsumen terhadap kondisi keuangan.
learningTip: Kolokasi ekonomi baku: consumer confidence, consumer spending, market stability.
